subject: Part5_daysummary activity duration in the day

messages.author: 026f8a5cf23ad486
messages.subject: Part5_daysummary activity duration in the day
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am confused by the output from the part5_daysummary csv. file (I attached one example output).

My understanding is that "dur_day_LIG30_100_min" is time spent in unbouted light activity during the day, while "dur_LIGB_D...T30_100_min" is time spent in bouted light activity during the day. So adding up these variables would be the total time spent in light activity during the day (which would be the variable "dur_TLIGday_min"). However, the sum of the unbouted and bouted values did not equals to the "dur_TLIGday_min" ("dur_day_LIG30_100_min"+"dur_LIGB_D10T30_100_min" + "dur_LIGB_D5T30_100_min" + "dur_LIGB_D1T30_100_min"  <  "dur_TLIGday_min"). The is the same for moderate activity.

On the contrary, adding up "dur_day_SIB_min", "dur_day_OIN30_min", "dur_INB_D30T30_min", "dur_INB_D10T30_min" and "dur_INB_D1T30_min" > "dur_TINday_min". The missing in total light and moderate activity = the extra in TIN. 

I wonder why some inactivity would be regarded as light or moderate activity at the end? Do anyone have any ideas about it? Thank you!

Anjo

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Part5_daysummary activity duration in the day
parts:
Hi Anjo,

Can you tell how did you define "bout.metric" and "closedbout" parameters? Depending on that, the bout breaks would be counted towards bout or not (thus, the reallocations you are reporting).
I would suggest you using "bout.metric = 4".

Best,
Jairo

Hi 

I just wanted to add more info and rephrase my questions.  So I am using bout.metric=4.  I see from the manual that the closedbout function only works if you are using bout.metric 1 or 2.  

Can you please confirm that my understanding of my output variables from part5_daysummary is correct.  

The below equation is t Total Light days Minutes minus bouted and unbouted minutes of light activity.  

lightdif  =   dur_TLIGday_min_n - (dur_day_LIG45_100_min_n + dur_LIGB_D10T45_100_min_n + dur_LIGB_D5T45_100_min_n + dur_LIGB_D1T45_100_min_n)

As show in the attached file, lightdif is nonzero.  My understanding is lightdif represented light activity that occurs within bouts of inactivity or MVPA.  Is that correct?

thank you,

Joanne

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Part5_daysummary activity duration in the day
parts:
Yes that is true and light bouts include non-light gaps. So, this explains why these variables do not add up.
A good way to improve or check your understanding is by feeding artificial time series to the g.getbout function. In that way you can see with your own eyes how every epoch is counted or excluded from the bouted time.

Vincent
